items.description: Renames the root package to `top-right` and the scaffold to `top-right-workspace-template`, sets the project slug in `.agents/preferences.yaml` to `top-right`, and resets both packages to `0.0.0` with the template's release history cleared from their changelogs. (#3)

Upgrades Node.js from 24 to 26 by pinning 26.13.1 in `.tool-versions`, raising the `engines.node` floor to `>=26` in the root and every workspace manifest, and moving `@types/node` in the catalog from 24.19.2 to 26.6.6. (#105)
